payload.independence_basis: The repository's strategy lab froze candidates on chronological development seasons and evaluated them against Deadeye and the market on a separate held-out season block; this is a historical protocol review, not a prospective Thursday-lock validation.
evidence: docs/lab-2026-10-26.md reports a development edge of +0.0021 log loss per game versus Deadeye, with a 95% interval from -0.0009 to +0.0052.
docs/lab-2026-10-26.md reports held-out performance of -0.0043, with a 95% interval from -0.0077 to -0.0009; the candidate was worse on that report split.
The same report says 2023-2026 had prior exposure under strategy-lab-1; treat the holdout as informative but not fully pristine.
tests/test_strategy_lab.py passed 26 tests in this audit, including common-game scoring, cutoff/lock protections, leakage checks, small-sample rejection, and no-edge/no-nomination gates.
tests/test_model_lab.py passed 38 tests, including late/missing timestamp exclusion and timezone/cutoff checks.
payload.decision: Reject. Development performance does not survive the reported held-out comparison, and this historical midweek study cannot establish exact Thursday cutoff parity or prospective production value.
